svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 02 · Berkeley · 12/12 Fog at the Gate (Common)
svg.desc: Late afternoon the fog pours in through the Golden Gate like it has somewhere to be. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
